summary: Verified About Us hero padding fix on desktop (1920x800) and mobile (390x800). Computed padding-top on .au-hero-side-col is 0px on both viewports. On desktop, paragraph top edge is exactly level with group photo top edge (0.0px difference). On mobile, .au-hero-side-col padding-top is 0px; residual 32px gap between photo bottom and paragraph is from flex row-gap between stacked columns (intended layout spacing, not padding on the column). Hero heading renders, and 'Get in touch' CTA correctly routes to /contact. No regressions observed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: About Us hero padding fix verified. .au-hero-side-col padding-top:0 confirmed on desktop and mobile. Paragraph aligns with photo top on desktop (diff=0px). CTA routes to /contact. Screenshots at .screenshots/desktop_about.png and mobile_about.png.
